log.text: Front calipers read on the car. Passenger/right GM 19141004 (ACDelco 18FR755). Driver/left GM 19141005 (ACDelco 18FR756). Single piston, S10 1983–1997. 19141914 is a rear number and is not these. Not on an invoice.
Spindle castings read on the knuckles. Right 459756, left 459755. G-body / 2WD S10 family. These are knuckles, not calipers. Not on an invoice.

Radiator-to-block hose burst. Stamps EOSA3AG1 (also read E0SA3AG1) and E09 AG 1 are factory marks, not a part number. On the intact hose, thumb and middle finger just meet, which matches a 1-1/2 in inside stick, about 1.89 in outside. The blown end was flared. Gates 28432 is the 3/4 in heater hose from 2011. Buy Gates 24024, NAPA 609, Dayco 76150, or Continental 56024: 1-1/2 in × 3 ft, SAE 20R1, 60 psi. 60 psi is the hose rating. The cap holds the system around 13–16 psi, and the GM 3.0 manual says not to pressure-test above 20 psi. Gates 24224 is the same size at 100 psi. If the 1-1/2 in hose is loose, the neck is the JEGS 555-53082 barb and the stick is Gates 24020 or NAPA 605. O'Reilly listing: https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco/gates-vulco-coolant-hose/gatg/24024 Not bought yet. No receipt.
